name: Vertcoin
rootCause: Vertcoin suffered a major attack in which hackers stole funds worth $100,000.

descriptions.text: Vertcoin suffered a major attack in which hackers stole funds worth $100,000.

Vertcoin suffered a series of 51% attacks between October and December 2018, resulting in repeated chain reorganizations and reported double-spending losses estimated at $100,000. The attacker rented large amounts of hashpower to overpower the Vertcoin network, enabling deep reorganizations and successful double-spend transactions mainly targeting exchanges. The root cause was Vertcoin's vulnerability to 51% attacks due to insufficient mining decentralization. The attacker rented hashpower via cloud mining services, gained control of the chain, and orchestrated deep reorgs to double-spend deposited coins.
